title: Sequence-to-function reanalysis of the SORT1 1p13.3 cholesterol locus: analysis code
description: Analysis code, compact source data, and figure-generation code for a computational reanalysis of the SORT1 1p13.3 cholesterol locus with AlphaGenome. Includes a clean-room reproducibility runner (reproduce.py) that downloads public inputs and calls the AlphaGenome API fresh for every prediction.
